name: Low nailwort
desc: Low nailwort (Paronychia sessiliflora): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 7 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Paronychia sessiliflora, the creeping nailwort, is a plant in the family Cayophyllaceae known from arid and semi arid environments in North America other common names include low nailwort.
